decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - Details of the proposed wall, palisade fence and ball finials at a scale of 1:20 shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby approved is commenced, and  the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby approved is commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
description: Erection of a new boundary enclosure fronting Woodstock Road & Blenheim Road to existing dwellinghouse
